claims.text: In Anambra State, no court makes an order for possession unless satisfied that suitable alternative accommodation is available for the tenant.
A landlord may not resort to self-help, as unlawful eviction is actionable in damages.

post.headline: Anambra court will not eject a tenant without this proof
lines: In Anambra State, no court makes an order for possession unless satisfied that suitable alternative
accommodation is available for the tenant.
A landlord may not resort to self-help, as unlawful eviction is actionable in damages.
Proper court process protects both sides when recovering possession of premises.
post.cta: Have you ever faced this in Anambra? Tell us below.

threads.text: In Anambra State, a court will not make an order to eject a tenant unless satisfied that suitable alternative accommodation is available. Landlords cannot resort to self-help. Did your landlord follow proper court process?
threads.evening: Self-help lockouts fail in court. Proper notice is the only valid way to recover property in Anambra.

why: Sunday engagement post on Anambra alternative accommodation rule to drive comments and engagement among landlords like Mr Okafor.
